records.claim: Information on the use of carvedilol in breastfeeding is limited. It is expected to pass into breast milk in small amounts. In a study looking at other beta-blockers (not including carvedilol) during breastfeeding, no increased chance of side effects was reported. If you suspect the baby has any symptoms (such as irritability, low energy levels, or being too sleepy), contact your child’s healthcare provider. Be sure to talk to your healthcare provider about all your breastfeeding questions.
